summary: The Gateway's one cold owner-brain turn is paid right after each start (brain-warm.py, launched by gateway-start.sh and awaited by companion-deploy.sh before the five paths), not by Amine's first message. The typed tool description says a refused or cancelled recap is a cancel call with the same values. The Pulse room shows invalid_interpretation as its own phrase instead of the generic « n'a pas abouti ».
reason: Deploy acceptance 30/10 on the S24: owner_read took 65.6 s. Gateway logs: after every Gateway start (29/10 16:52, 19:54, 20:23; 30/10 08:23 UTC) the first main-agent run blocked the whole Gateway 41-62 s (« liveness heartbeat delayed », WhatsApp dropped with 408), then loaded plugin tools for 8-10 s; the second run of the same process took 8.2 s. Same run: the owner's « Annule, ne l'ajoute pas. » made no call (recap left AWAITING_CONFIRMATION), and the room's « Annule la demande en cours » refused as invalid_interpretation read « La préparation ou la vérification de cette commande n'a pas abouti ».

architecture.reason: A one-shot helper started by the existing Gateway start script and called by the existing deploy; no daemon, schedule, store or retry engine. It reuses the Gateway agent command already used by the deploy paths.

evidence: Gateway start/deploy scripts, typed tool description and room failure phrase.

limitations: The Gateway still blocks once per start; the cost moves to about 20 s after the start, when no one waits. A message arriving in that window still waits for it.
One included-model turn per Gateway start, in the dedicated session agent:main:brain-warm.
The cancel wording depends on the brain making the call; live proof is deploy path 4 followed by a journal check (goal CANCELLED).
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the core.
